methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Document360 and Guru publish no self-serve USD prices — all plans require a sales quote; recorded as null/custom. Helpjuice prices confirmed on official pricing page (3 flat-rate plans). Slab prices from official pricing page — annual rates ($6.67 and $12.50/user/month) confirmed; the official page publishes only annual per-user rates, so per-user monthlyUsd for Startup and Business is null (the previously-recorded $12 and $25/user/month monthly figures could not be confirmed by any credible source). Notion USD prices sourced from softwareadvice.com (official page renders EUR for this environment); Plus $12/$10 and Business $24/$18 per user per month confirmed. Nuclino prices from softwareadvice.com (official page renders without price values for this environment); Starter $6, Business $10 per user per month confirmed via getapp.com. Slite prices (Basic $10, Pro $20/user/month billed annually) confirmed on official page; monthly-only rate not published. Tettra prices ($8/user/month, 10-user minimum) confirmed on official page with 20% annual discount. Slashdot.org and softwareadvice.com used as corroboration sources where available. All accessedAt dates set to 2026-06-14.

vendors.name: Document360
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://document360.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Page displays three plan tiers (Professional, Business, Enterprise) but shows only 'Get a quote' buttons with zero published USD figures. All plans require sales contact for pricing. GetApp profile confirmed no pricing info available.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Quote-only. 'Built for growing teams to scale documentation efficiently.' No published USD price; requires sales quote.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Quote-only. 'Advanced features and tracking controls for mid-sized teams.' Integrations include Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Slack, Teams, Drift, Zapier, Make, GitHub.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Yearly plan only per page. Adds Salesforce, Crowdin, Phrase. 'Custom AI solutions for enterprises with high-scale and high-security needs.'

vendors.name: Helpjuice
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://helpjuice.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Three flat-rate plans displayed with explicit USD prices: $249, $449, $799/month. No annual billing toggle visible. SOC 2 certified, GDPR ready; no HIPAA/BAA mention. 14-day free trial with full feature access.

plans.name: Knowledge Base
plans.notes: Flat monthly rate. Includes 30 users and 12GB file storage. Core features, no AI suite.

plans.name: AI-Knowledge Base
plans.notes: Flat monthly rate. Includes 100 users and 24GB file storage. Full AI suite included at no extra cost.

plans.name: Unlimited AI-Knowledge Base
plans.notes: Flat monthly rate. Unlimited users, 38GB storage, full AI suite plus unlimited customization credits.

vendors.name: Guru
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.getguru.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. Page explicitly states 'Guru is a platform and expertise solution — not just a per-seat tool. Your investment is tailored to your organization's scale, knowledge complexity, and AI maturity.' No USD prices published. All visitors directed to 'Talk to sales' / 'Book a call.' HIPAA compliance explicitly mentioned ('SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GxP compliance'). 100+ integrations listed.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Quote-only. Pricing tailored to organization scale, knowledge complexity, and AI maturity. Includes platform access plus solution engineering, architecture design, and ongoing optimization. Non-profit program available at reduced cost.

vendors.name: Slab
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://slab.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Annual rates ($6.67, $12.50/user/month) confirmed directly on the page. Official page displays ONLY annual per-user rates; no flat monthly per-user rate is published (monthly billing uses a base fee for the first 10 users plus a per-additional-user rate). The previously-recorded monthly figures ($12, $25/user/month) could not be confirmed by the official page or any credible corroboration source and were set to null. 30-day money-back guarantee. No HIPAA/BAA mention found.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 10 users, 3 guests per user, 10MB attachment limit, 90-day version history.

plans.name: Startup
plans.notes: Annual rate: $6.67/user/month billed annually (confirmed on official pricing page). Monthly per-user rate could not be confirmed — official page displays only the annual rate, and the previously-recorded $12/user/month figure does not match any credible source (corroboration indicates monthly billing uses a $40/mo base for the first 10 users plus $6.67/additional user, not a flat $12/user). monthlyUsd set to null pending a confirmable per-user monthly figure. Unlimited users, 5 guests per user, 25MB attachments, 365-day version history.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Annual rate: $12.50/user/month billed annually (confirmed on official pricing page). Monthly per-user rate could not be confirmed — official page displays only the annual rate, and the previously-recorded $25/user/month figure does not match any credible source (corroboration indicates monthly billing uses a $75/mo base for the first 10 users plus $12.50/additional user, not a flat $25/user). monthlyUsd set to null pending a confirmable per-user monthly figure. Unlimited users and guests, 100MB attachments, unlimited version history.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. 100+ users minimum. Custom attachment limits and version history. Contact sales@slab.com.

vendors.name: Notion
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.notion.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14 but rendered prices in EUR for this geographic environment. USD prices sourced from softwareadvice.com/knowledge-management/notion-profile/ (corroboration source) which confirms Plus $12/month and $10/year, Business $24/month and $18/year per user. Annual discount calculated from published monthly vs annual rates.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Unlimited pages and blocks for individuals. Collaborative workspace up to a limited block count for teams. Guests included free.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Monthly rate: $12/user/month. Annual rate: $10/user/month billed annually (~17% discount). Unlimited blocks for teams, 30-day page history. Only workspace members are paid seats; guests are free.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Monthly rate: $24/user/month. Annual rate: $18/user/month billed annually (25% discount). Adds GitHub, Asana and more integrations, 90-day page history, SAML SSO, advanced analytics.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Custom pricing via sales. Includes advanced security, audit logs, dedicated success manager, custom data retention.

vendors.name: Nuclino
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.nuclino.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14 but rendered without numerical price values (JS-rendered content). USD prices sourced from softwareadvice.com and getapp.com which both confirm Starter $6/user/month and Business $10/user/month. Slashdot.org lists paid plans starting at $5/user/month annually — this may reflect a different toggle state or older data; softwareadvice.com/$6 figure used as primary. Annual discount advertised as 'up to 25% off' on official page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 50 items, 3 canvases, 2GB total storage.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Monthly rate: $6/user/month per softwareadvice.com and getapp.com. Annual billing available at 'up to 25% off' per official page but exact annual rate not captured from official source. Unlimited items and canvases, 10GB storage per user, 30-day version history, groups, private workspaces.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Monthly rate: $10/user/month per softwareadvice.com and getapp.com. Annual billing available at 'up to 25% off' per official page but exact annual rate not captured from official source. Adds Sidekick AI, audit log, advanced security controls, SAML SSO, unlimited version history, 20GB storage per user.

vendors.name: Slite
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://slite.com/pricing accessed 2026-06-14. Basic $10 and Pro $20 per user/month explicitly stated as billed annually. Monthly-only rates not published on page. HIPAA and BAA explicitly stated as Enterprise-only. GetApp confirms Basic $10 and Pro $20/user/month.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Price is $10/user/month billed annually. Monthly-only rate not published. Includes unlimited docs, AI search (30 monthly questions/seat), doc verification workflow, Knowledge Management Panel, MCP/API access.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Price is $20/user/month billed annually. Monthly-only rate not published. Adds Slite Agent, cross-tool search, doc fact-checking, agent workflows, 50 monthly credits/seat, OpenID SSO, custom domain for public docs.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Adds reader-only seats, advanced security controls, audit logs, SLA, dedicated account manager, custom data sources, migration support, SCIM provisioning. HIPAA compliance and BAA available on this tier.

vendors.name: Tettra
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://tettra.com/pricing/ accessed 2026-06-14. Scaling plan at $8/user/month with 10-user minimum confirmed. 20% annual discount explicitly shown as 'Billed Yearly (20% off)' toggle on page. Annual rate ($6.40/user/month) calculated from official discount. Enterprise is custom pricing.

plans.name: Scaling
plans.notes: Monthly rate: $8/user/month with 10-user minimum. Annual rate: ~$6.40/user/month billed annually (20% discount per official page). Includes AI features (answers, page tagging, FAQ generation), unlimited storage, guest/read-only roles, API access. 30-day free trial, no credit card required.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only. Custom pricing with discounted rates for 250+ licenses. Adds SSO and SCIM, hands-on training, custom import/onboarding, priority support.
